title: Easy 7UP Biscuits
subtitle: Super easy, fluffy, buttery, mouthwatering biscuits you can enjoy with any meal

story.title: The Secret to Perfect Biscuits
paragraphs: Sometimes the most wonderful things come from the simplest ingredients! These 7UP biscuits are proof that you don't need to spend hours in the kitchen to create something absolutely delicious.

The carbonation in the soda creates the most amazing light, fluffy texture - it's like magic! I discovered this recipe when I was looking for something quick to serve unexpected guests, and now it's become one of my most requested treats. 🥤✨

ingredientGroups.title: Simple Ingredients
items: ½ cup 7UP or Sprite (or any lemon-lime soda)

steps.title: Preheat and Mix
steps.body: Heat your oven to 450°F. In a medium bowl, stir together 2 cups of baking mix, the soda, and sour cream until just combined. Don't overmix - lumpy is lovely!

steps.title: Prepare the Dough
steps.body: Sprinkle the counter with the remaining baking mix and dump the dough out on it. Get some flour on your hands and pat the dough out to about ½ inch thick.

steps.title: The Magic Fold
steps.body: Fold the dough into quarters, then pat down again to about ½ inch thick. This creates those beautiful flaky layers!

steps.title: Butter Bath
steps.body: Pour the melted butter into a pie pan or 8x8 baking dish. Cut the biscuits out and place them in the pan of butter - they should be sitting in that golden goodness!

steps.title: Bake to Perfection
steps.body: Bake for 13 to 16 minutes until cooked through and golden brown. Your kitchen will smell absolutely divine!

tips.title: Sides Touching
tips.body: When placing the biscuits in the pan, make sure their sides are touching. This helps them rise higher and stay soft!

tips.title: Foil Protection
tips.body: If the tops start to get too dark, lay a piece of foil on top of the partially cooked biscuits to finish cooking without burning.

tips.title: Soda Magic
tips.body: The carbonation in the soda is what makes these so light and fluffy - don't use flat soda!

tips.title: Butter Bath
tips.body: Don't skip the butter in the pan - it creates the most amazing crispy bottom and keeps them moist!

footer.heading: Happy Baking!
footer.text: These biscuits are perfect with honey, jam, or just a pat of butter. Enjoy every buttery bite! 💕
